clips.title: The story
paras: Call to Arms is a Horde martial trial issued by Drum Fel at the Hammerfall outpost in the Arathi Highlands. Having proven their basic combat readiness, adventurers are ordered southwest toward the dwarven bridge to engage the dangerous Boulderfist ogres. Eliminating both front-line brutes and spellcasting magi tests the warrior's resolve while protecting the Horde's vulnerable foothold in Arathi.

At the isolated Horde redoubt of Hammerfall, survival demands unwavering martial strength. Drum Fel, recognizing the growing capabilities of travelers aiding the outpost, refuses to let anyone rest on easy victories. Rather than facing minor skirmishers, warriors must prove their mettle against what Fel considers a genuine threat: the hulking Boulderfist ogres. These brutes have consistently harassed the Horde expedition and tested the resolve of Hammerfall’s defenders. Fel offers simple terms for the task—warriors are expected to return successful in flesh or honorably in spirit, with praise promised for sheer tenacity in battle.

The Boulderfist clan has established an entrenched lair southwest of Hammerfall, extending their territory toward the grand dwarven bridge connecting Arathi to the Wetlands. Unlike undisciplined beasts, the ogres command both crushing physical power and lethal mystical arts, fielding durable brutes alongside cunning magi. Their aggressive presence poses a direct challenge to the Horde's supply lines and regional dominance. By ordering the destruction of ten Boulderfist brutes and four magi, Drum Fel seeks to blunt their strength, ensuring the Boulderfists understand that the warriors of Hammerfall will neither yield ground nor tolerate rivals in Arathi.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your strength is evident, friend. Now to see how you fare against a real enemy.

The Boulderfists have a lair to the southwest of here towards the dwarven bridge, and, if I'm not mistaken, the maulers and magi there shall present to you a greater challenge--they have done so to us thus far.
Slay as many as you can and come to me in body when you are successful, or come to me in spirit when you fail. I shall give praise to your tenacity in battle either way.
